title: Mexico City bank money in Bernard Barker's pocket traced to casino skim

tellings.quote: assassination wow because that bank account where those monies came out of where those bills were in Bernard Barker's pocket was in the bank account of this lawyer by the name of agario

plain: The cash found in the pocket of a man named Bernard Barker, arrested in 1972, came from a Mexico City bank account belonging to a lawyer whose name sounds like "Agario", and that money, the story goes, traces back to money skimmed from casinos. A researcher named Dan Sheehan tells this without naming a source, and he ties the account to the New Orleans crime boss Carlos Marcello and to an assassination. If true, it would join a 1972 political scandal to organised crime money going back to the early 1960s.
